technology_name: Essential Oil Recovery Technology for Spices and Aromatic Plants
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for economically viable, small-scale multipurpose extraction of essential oils to generate income for farmers.
description: Technology for the recovery of flavour and essential oils from various spices and aromatic plants (like ginger, pepper, cardamom, betel leaf, etc.) using a small scale multipurpose distillation facility.
applications: • Manufacturing of spice flavors and oleoresins • Production of essential oils for perfumery • Processing of botanical extracts for medicinal applications • Deployment in small-scale rural multipurpose distillation facilities
secondary_sector: Food Technology, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, MedTech & Health Care, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
